'''Ozz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] and an ancestral leader of the [[Irden]] tribe who maintained his headquarters in the city of [[Ugnorgrad/Legends|Ugnorgrad]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].

==Biography==
Born approximately two hundred years prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Ozz was one of many of his kind to manage the [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas refineries in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].

[[3 ABY/Legends|Three years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], King Ozz led the disgruntled Ugnaught workers in a revolt against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] garrison that had taken control of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. They planted bombs throughout the city and retreated to their marshland haven at Ugnorgrad. Cloud City's [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] agent, [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]], disconnected all of the bombs, preventing them from exploding.<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 57" />

Soon after, the former [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], approached King Ozz and pledged to help the Ugnaughts retake Cloud City. Ozz sent a contingent of his workers, as well as a [[Action Tidings|news crew]], to aid in the assault. With the help of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Lumiya|Shira Brie]], Ozz's allies successfully ousted the corrupt Imperial administrator, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hugo Treece]].<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 57" />
